facts.text: Simba, a grub a day keeps the hyenas away. Okay, that isn't true. Eat them anyway, they're crunchy.
facts.why: Pumbaa never says this. At the grub log his real line is 'Slimy, yet satisfying.' Timon's is 'Mmm. Now, that's what I call umami.'

vibe.verdict: Nearly the same menu as the 1994 film with a few swaps, and it ignores what makes the remake different, so a fan would not grin.
missing: Slimy, yet satisfying and the umami joke (the grub log)
Scar and the mouse, 'Life is not fair, is it, my little friend?'
Zazu's 'This is not a drill' announcement
Pumbaa saving Simba from the vultures
The animals crowding the log to feast on grubs
ideas: Swap 'Crispy puffed rice noodles' for 'Umami grubs' crispy noodle clusters named after Timon's joke
Swap 'Vetkoek with apricot jam' note 'Timon's bug list, minus the bugs.' for 'Slimy, yet satisfying, but it is jam'
Swap 'Pride Rock beef samosas' note for 'Not a drill' (Zazu's announcement)
Add a mouse-sized sweet nodding to Scar's lunch to replace one of the generic South African dishes shared with the 1994 menu
